sections.heading: Questions, answered
sections.intro: Can’t find what you’re looking for? Visit our

items.question: Who can join #paid as a creator?
items.answer: Anyone with a public Instagram or TikTok profile can apply. We typically look for an audience of 10,000 or more and an engagement rate above 1.5%. It’s free to join.

items.question: How do I set my rates?
items.answer: You set your own rates in your account settings for content, Instagram, TikTok and usage rights, and you can adjust them for each collaboration when you opt in. Keep them accurate, since they help us match you with brands whose budgets fit.

items.question: When do I get paid?
items.answer: Once a brand approves your content (or your post insights are validated), your payment starts a 30-day processing cycle. You’re then paid on the next 15th or last day of the month, and it lands in your account one to three days later. You can track every payment under Your Earnings.

items.question: How do brands find me?
items.answer: When a brand launches a campaign, we match creators to it by audience, location, engagement and content categories, then send you an opt-in with all the details. You can also raise your hand for open campaigns on the job board. Most creators see their first request within a few months.

items.question: What are usage rights?
items.answer: Every collaboration includes 12 months of owned and operated rights, so the brand can share your content on its own channels, website and newsletters. Brands can also buy more, like running ads with your content, which you price per month. More money, no extra work.

items.question: Do my social profiles need to be public?
items.answer: Yes. Brands need to discover your work, and we need to see how your posts perform so you get paid.

items.question: What if a brand closes a campaign early?
items.answer: If you’d already submitted content, you’re paid between 25% and 100%, depending on how far the collaboration got, and you don’t have to post it. If you hadn’t submitted anything yet, the collaboration simply closes.
